Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 153. Category: stance. Stances.

Prerequisites: 1 leveled spell
You can draw the most out of your spells.
+1 Static Bonus to spells
Choose 1 school of Magic; while in this stance the
base range of all spells of this school with a range
greater than self or touch by 50%, this can not be
changed later.
You get 1 metamagic feature of your choice, that
cannot be changed later.
